title: The Quest for the Golden Sword

sentences.text: In a small village, there lived a brave girl named Lila.
One day, she heard a story.
The story was about a golden sword.
She wanted to be a hero.
She took food, water, and a map.
She said goodbye to her mom.
"I will be back soon!" she said.
Lila walked into the dark forest.
The dragon was green and fierce.
But she remembered the golden sword.
After a long time, Lila found a cave.
Inside the cave, she saw the golden sword.
Now, she was ready for more!
